chapter: Chicago bands and the Charlie Cook circle
title: Charlie Cook's organ band at Paddy Harmon's Dreamland
summary: Cook pioneered organ in dance bands at Dreamland with Keppard, Noone and Bertrand; Burton visited and sat in on drums.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: specialized on piano then in organ I guess
too didn't he special in piano and organ and he was the first one to introduce
organ in the dance band business and we had one in Harman's Dreamland

I used to go out there to see him quite often when he was there and there was another with it like I did and I was doubling on piano drums and singing and playing clown on this instrument when I came out to visit him after Patty Harmon Dreamland and they had Freddie Keppin from New Orleans and Jimmy Noon was in the band and Jimmy Bertrand was on drums and

Bertrand was the one that caused me to go out there to visit ! man he said why don't come in that place when I had that little band down there I said it was swinging them clasps so I said all right Jimmy I'm going to go out there one Sunday with you just for curiosity and surprise Charlie and it was a surprise when I went out there see him and so all the boys just fell in love with me and

Buster he was playing bells and vibraphones and doubling on drums and so I went out there and so we made cream with all of them and Norman Buster he wanted me to play a little bit on drums because Charlie hadn't ever dreamed I was playing drums until he heard Bobby and his band and I went make that ring so Charlie says to me I'll put you in my band on drums I said I appreciate you thinking that much of and trying to give me my second start in the way of life because if I stayed with you I would have been playing trumpet I said but listen these boys and this girl is playing piano they all think so much of me and I I just couldn't think of Charlie anyway else I would rather stay with my bunch and I said I appreciate it very much so Charlie used to get me the number two job out there Lorraine Garden on State Street when it was going and boom and play a while until he come from his job on that job and I was playing drums in Norman Buster's place
